input.title: Women's Lineman – Line Wife (Plans Tentative) Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

A patient housewife in a headscarf rests her chin on her hand at the kitchen table, a covered dinner plate and a single candle beside her, while a tiny bucket truck works a utility pole in the rainy window, and the sweatshirt says LINE WIFE (plans tentative). This lineman sweatshirt is for the line wife whose storm-call evenings, birthdays and holiday dinners are always tentative.

The print is a 1960s kitchen scene: a woman in a red checked headscarf and a mint cardigan leaning on a small round table with a domed plate and a red candle, a rainy window behind her with a utility pole and a small bucket truck. LINE WIFE is in red slab capitals above and (plans tentative) in navy script below.

Wear it to the storm-season dinner for one, the crew family cookout or a cold night on the porch, and give it to the line wife who has learned to keep the plate covered. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Line Wife (Plans Tentative) sweatshirt?
It is a crewneck sweatshirt from Graphic Tees Co. showing a patient wife at the table with a covered dinner plate while a bucket truck works a pole outside, lettered LINE WIFE (plans tentative). It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, with no hood and no pockets.

How does the crewneck sweatshirt fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a roomier layer over a tee. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The sweatshirt is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a cold evening or a long wait on the porch. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the red and navy inks from fading and the fleece soft after many washes.

Is it a good gift for a line wife?
Yes. It suits the line wife herself, a friend whose husband works storm calls, or a gift from the lineman. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $34.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a birthday, an anniversary or Christmas.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. lineman sweatshirt should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
